description: This file defines an Angular component named 'NotesListComponent' that displays a list of notes, allows requesting deletion of a note, confirming deletion, and cancelling the delete operation. It interacts with a notes service to fetch and delete notes, and uses Angular signals for managing deletion confirmation state.

classes.name: NotesListComponent
classes.description: Angular component for listing notes, handling delete actions with confirmation, using signals for state management.

methods.name: onRequestDelete
methods.description: Sets the confirmDeleteId signal to the specified note ID, triggering delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: confirmDeletion
methods.description: Deletes the note with the ID stored in confirmDeleteId, then clears the confirmation signal.

methods.name: cancelDeletion
methods.description: Resets the confirmDeleteId signal to null, cancelling the delete operation.
